info.title: BeatX API - mobile developer handoff
info.description: Exported offline from current compiled controllers and DTOs, without connecting to application services. Amounts are integer BDT paisa; wallet amounts are coins. Payments remain dummy test mode. Response schemas may allow additive fields; API_CHANGES_FOR_APPS.md documents client migration and dynamic responses. This source export is not a deployment or an observed live response capture.
